scope: Every authored map cell, all three animation phases, concealed and revealed block variants, and front overlays. All map storage includes unreachable/offscreen staging data; not a claim of playthrough.
limits: An atlas record is not proof of authored high-resolution detail.
Mixed connected stage1 still contains source-reconstructed objects.
Banquet source-reconstructed cells partly belong to whole HD cherries; flagged per record, not counted as exact pixel coverage.
Final boss A includes tile-composed art, not only sprites.
Counts are per-stage distinct physical tile records, not pixel-area percentages.
